title: Read a path value
summary: Spring Boot: Read a path value. Visit /hello/Asha.
introduction: @PathVariable reads a value from a named path position. Open GET /hello/Ravi.
learningObjectives: Read a path value with Spring Boot

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save one example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. JBang downloads the dependency on the //DEPS line. Use http://127.0.0.1:8080 and stop the server before another example.

blocks.title: Read a path value

blocks.text: The explicit path-variable name matches the placeholder. Spring passes Ravi to the method.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use the explicit input name so compilation settings do not affect binding.
